name: Bottleneck

subjectOf.text: Micro task platform systems carry significant limitations that hold back the evolution of AI itself, so platform design is a bottleneck on AI progress rather than a peripheral concern.
subjectOf.abstract: But alas, microtasks platform systems are subject to significant limitations that inhibit the evolution of AI.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Mechanical Turk Through Verified Reputation (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3128900

subjectOf.text: Concentrating too much power in any single office of a hierarchy creates a decision making bottleneck that can cripple the organization, so the tree structure that is optimal for transmitting orders downward is also its point of paralysis.
subjectOf.abstract: However, if too much power is held in any single office in the hierarchy, de- cision making finds a bottleneck that can cripple the organization.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Introduction to Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782192
scope_conditions: centralized tree structures with concentrated decision rights
